title: Broadsheet: 48 Letters, Notices and Coins Drawn From Your Game Data, for Godot 4
shortText: Letters, wanted posters and coins your Godot 4 game draws from its own data: 48 presets, 12 hands, no fonts.
html:
Broadsheet: letters, notices and coins drawn from your game data, for Godot 4

Broadsheet is a Godot 4.7 addon that draws the documents your players read and the money they hold, from your game's own data: 48 presets (16 letters, 16 notices, 16 coins), 12 handwriting hands, 8 type faces, generated paper, ink, wax seals and struck metal. Hand it a name, a sum, a few lines of text or a portrait and it draws a sealed letter, a wanted poster with your character printed as a woodcut, or a coin with your king struck in gold. No font file and no painted document ships: every stroke is drawn at runtime. A free MIT lite (12 presets) is on this page. Royalty free in your games.

var poster := BroadsheetNotice.new()
poster.preset = "wanted_frontier"
poster.data = {"name": "MAGGIE VANCE", "crime": "CATTLE THEFT", "reward": "$200",
               "portrait": preload("res://art/maggie.png")}
$Board.add_child(poster)

Any field you leave out falls back to the preset's own sample, so every preset draws something the moment you add it.

16 letters

Royal Summons, Love Letter, Field Dispatch, Ransom Note, Last Testament, Merchant Ledger, Cipher Slip, Abbey Missive, Frightened Plea, Smugglers Scrap, Telegram, Postcard, Sealed Envelope, Letterlocked Packet, Decree Scroll, Diary Page. Each is written with a broad nib swept along authored letter skeletons in one of 12 hands (chancery, copperplate, uncial, secretary, a frightened tremble, an untutored scrawl and more) on one of 20 paper stocks, folded, foxed, water stained or scorched as the preset says, and sealed in one of 10 waxes. A ledger sums its own amount column; a cipher slip shifts and groups your text by five.

16 notices

Frontier Wanted, Warden Bounty, Missing Person, Beast Bounty, Royal Proclamation, Theatre Bill, Fair Poster, Recruitment Poster, Quarantine Notice, Auction Lots, Job Board Card, Newspaper Front, Election Poster, Tavern Chalkboard, Coach Timetable, Court Summons. Printed in 8 type faces a jobbing printer would own, with your portrait printed through a shader as a woodcut, engraving, halftone, stipple, stencil, linocut, riso or sepia print. Rubber stamps, nails, tacks and tape hold them up.

16 coins

Gold Crown, Hammered Penny, Square Hole Cash, Bronze Tower, Electrum Stater, Guild Token, Siege Coin, Tavern Token, Ship Ducat, Silver Thaler Pair, Bimetal Two, Copper Stack, Holed Sun, Clipped Silver, Valour Medal, Jade Token. Every coin, token and medal is a height buffer lit as gold, silver, copper, bronze, electrum, brass, iron, pewter or jade, struck with any of 24 devices or with YOUR texture as the bust. Shapes: round, hammered, lump, octagonal, scalloped, square, clipped; holes, beaded, reeded or wreathed rims, bimetal, pairs, stacks, strung cash and medals.

Your data, your style

  • data: the names, sums, dates and lines of text, plus a portrait Texture2D on notices and coins.
  • style: any key of the preset laid over it, so one preset becomes yours (another hand, another stock, a silver coin, a new legend).
  • age yellows, foxes and browns a sheet; variation moves the deckle, wobble and wear without changing the style.
  • export_png() saves the document; make_sprite() puts it anywhere in your world.

It draws once

A document bakes into its own buffer when you change it and then costs one textured quad per frame. Plain GDScript and canvas shaders, no GDExtension, no plugin to enable.

Both renderers, tested

Every preset photographed by our pack gate under Forward+ and Compatibility (the renderer web exports use): 48 + 48 frames, zero engine errors, all 48 distinct. Godot 4.7.2; older versions were not run and are not claimed. The hands carry ASCII letters, digits and common punctuation.

Free lite on this page

Broadsheet Lite is free (MIT): 12 of the 48 presets (four of each kind), the same three Controls and the demo.

Install

Copy addons/broadsheet into your project. No plugin to enable. Run demo/demo.tscn to browse every preset.

Licence

Royalty free in your games, commercial use, no credit required. The seven painted demo portraits are included and yours to use. Edit and recolour freely. You may not resell or redistribute the files as an asset pack, addon or template. Plain language LICENSE.txt included.

AI disclosure, stated truthfully: the scripts, shaders, the sample letters and notices, and the demo were written with AI; the seven demo portraits and the cover were made by AI image models; every document is drawn by that code at runtime from your own data.
